To save a spell, click the list icon next to its rank on the Browse tab (or here). Pick one or more of your lists, or type a name to start a new one. The plus changes to a check mark once the spell is on a list.

Add to spell list

Spell data comes from a 11/16/2026 snapshot of the open-source Foundry VTT PF2e system (ORC license) spells, cantrips, focus spells and rituals. "How you get it", "Granted by" and "Modified by" come from matching feats, class features, heritages, items and the Domains list to the spells they name, so a few links may be missing or extra. Ratings summarize community spell guides; the rating for a chosen tradition or class is used when you pick one. Spell categories, conditions, target, range and duration groups are sorted from each spell's text, so check the full entry on Archives of Nethys. Pathfinder is a trademark of Paizo Inc.
